summary: Full regression + V2 refinement validation (customer order status & timing). Backend: 49/50 pytest cases pass, 1 skipped (delivery E2E skipped because the cheapest-item scenario hit the delivery minimum rejection path — that path is already covered elsewhere). Covered: email now required (missing/invalid -> 422), phone still required (-> 422), valid pickup order returns status='new', estimatedMinutes=null, a plaintext statusToken, and NO statusTokenHash in payload. /api/public/order-status/{token} returns safe projection (no statusToken/statusTokenHash/id/restaurantId/_id/idempotencyKey). Random token -> 404. Expired token (statusTokenExpiresAt in past, simulated in Mongo) -> 410. Legacy plaintext token fallback (simulated by setting legacy statusToken + unsetting hash) -> 200. Accept with estimatedMinutes 10/30/60 persists correctly, no HH:MM clock string emitted. PATCH /orders/{id}/eta to 45 persists and the public status page reflects it. Invalid minutes 0 / 9999 / -5 / -1 / 601 are all rejected 422 on both /status and /eta. Full workflow new->accepted->preparing->ready->completed enforced; illegal transition new->ready => 400; cancel-from-new and cancel-from-ready both allowed; completed is terminal. Tenant isolation: PATCH /orders/<other-id>/status and /eta on an id not owned by caller -> 404. Email toggles orderEmailsEnabled and customerEmailsEnabled are independently settable in Mongo via /restaurant/settings. Frontend E2E via Playwright on the deployed preview: pickup checkout button is disabled without email AND disabled for invalid email ('notanemail') AND enabled only with a valid email; order POST returns 200 with no statusTokenHash leak, redirects to /order-status/<token>; owner login -> /dashboard/bestellingen -> order card visible -> Accepteren dialog -> minute preset 30 -> PATCH /status returns 200 with estimatedMinutes=30 -> ETA edit dialog -> preset 45 -> PATCH /eta returns 200 -> /order-status/<token> renders exactly 'Verwachte bereidingstijd' + 'ongeveer 45 minuten' in the ETA panel.

issues: Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' on accept-dialog and eta-dialog. Pre-existing a11y gap (same note as iteration_1 for options/cart dialogs). Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional a11y) Add <DialogDescription> (or aria-describedby) to the accept/eta Radix dialogs in /app/frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Orders.jsx to silence the Radix console warning. Same for options/cart dialogs flagged previously.
critical_code_review_comments: public.py expired-token path: when statusTokenExpiresAt is missing on NEW orders, we fall back to createdAt + 30d — fine, but on orders where ObjectId's generation_time could be more reliable, consider the ObjectId timestamp as a secondary floor. Minor.
orders.py update_status silently no-ops when payload.status==current (returns 200, no notify). Acceptable per prior review; consider 409 for clarity.
models.py EtaReq.estimatedMinutes is int (non-optional). Good — mirrors validator. StatusReq.estimatedMinutes is Optional[int] which correctly allows 'accept without time' (skip button).

_order_result_with_token always derives a token for the client even for legacy orders missing statusToken; that is correct (lookup falls back to plaintext). Confirmed working via explicit legacy-fallback test.

Public /public/order-status response (safe projection) deliberately drops `id` — that is correct for the customer page; _public_order_view does NOT leak restaurantId / statusToken / statusTokenHash / idempotencyKey. Verified by explicit assertion.

Tenant isolation on /orders/{id}/status and /eta is enforced by the {_id, restaurantId} query filter (returns 404 when not owned). Verified with synthetic ObjectId (second restaurant not creatable from this suite).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Two pytest files now exist under /app/backend/tests/: test_upxero_backend.py (regression) and test_upxero_status_timing.py (V2 refinement). Run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL + MONGO_URL + DB_NAME set; pytest.ini uses pytest-xdist loadscope by default — override with `-o addopts=` if you want sequential. Expiry/legacy-fallback tests patch Mongo directly (MongoClient on MONGO_URL). The Emergent Resend provider may return 429 on bursts; emails are BackgroundTasks and do not fail order writes — this is confirmed by orders being persisted even when email bursts hit. Delivery E2E test skips if the cheapest-item 5x scenario falls below the zone minimum — not a bug.
